articles.title: Global Military Rotorcraft Market to Hit USD 29.21 Billion by 2035 – SNS Insider
articles.summary: The global Military Rotorcraft Market is projected for significant growth, from an estimated USD 21.10 billion in 2025 to USD 29.21 billion. This expansion signals increasing global demand for military helicopters and advanced rotorcraft. For SSB aspirants, this trend highlights a continued focus on airpower modernization and strategic defence procurement, emphasizing the critical role of robust aerial capabilities in modern defence.

articles.title: $1.5 Trillion Budget Request Prioritizes Service Members, Modernization
articles.summary: The US President's fiscal year 2027 budget request, a record $1.5 trillion, was publicly presented at the Pentagon. This substantial allocation, the largest of his presidency, outlines national spending priorities. For SSB aspirants, this highlights the immense financial commitment towards national interests, with a significant portion likely dedicated to defence, impacting future military capabilities, strategic projects, and personnel development.

articles.title: Requesting US Congressional Support for S. Korea's Nuclear Submarine Program
articles.summary: A representative from the Republic of Korea's Ministry of National Defense, Ahn Gyu-back, met with US Senators to discuss strengthening the Korea-US alliance. Discussions focused on key bilateral issues and fostering mutually beneficial cooperation between the two nations. This high-level engagement underscores ongoing efforts to enhance defence collaboration and strategic partnership.
